info.name: Odoo - Phieu ho tro
info.description: Dat base_url trong Postman Environment thanh domain Odoo dang su dung (gom http:// hoac https://, khong co dau / cuoi). De goi GET tickets khong dang nhap, dien api_key bang API key tao trong Odoo va chay truc tiep request 5. Cac request 2-4 dung session: nhap username/password va chay request 1 truoc. Endpoint /api/session/authenticate tu chon database duy nhat theo domain va cau hinh dbfilter/db_name cua server; khong can gui db. API dung route tuong doi, khong gan co dinh domain. Khong dung token auth.datgroup.com.vn.

variable.description: Domain Odoo hien tai, gom http:// hoac https:// va khong co dau / cuoi. Dat bien nay trong Environment cho tung moi truong. Postman can URL tuyet doi va khong tu suy ra domain cua website.
API key cua tai khoan Odoo co quyen doc tickets. Luu gia tri trong Environment; request 5 gui key qua header X-API-Key, khong can dang nhap.

request.description: Khong can truyen db. Server phai cau hinh domain khop dung mot database qua dbfilter hoac db_name. Dang nhap thanh cong tao session_id de goi cac API tickets.

item.name: 3. Tim phieu theo ma khach hang so huu

request.description: Dien card_code bang ma khach hang so huu (res.partner.card_code), vi du C020957. Response owner_id.card_code la ma khach hang.

item.name: 4. Tim tat ca phieu theo card_code trong Body JSON

request.description: Chay dang nhap truoc. Gui GET voi Body JSON card_code, vi du C020957; khong can Params. Tra tat ca phieu duoc phep xem cua khach hang so huu co ma chinh xac, khong phan trang.

item.name: 5. Lay phieu ho tro bang API key (khong dang nhap)

request.description: Chay truc tiep khong can request dang nhap. Dien api_key bang key tao tai My Profile/Preferences > Account Security > API Keys trong Odoo. Server tra tickets theo quyen va record rules cua chu key. Co the them query card_code de loc theo ma khach hang.
